name: two_offline_additions
operations: phone goes offline, adds account 'Work GitHub'
laptop goes offline, adds account 'Personal GitHub'
both devices come back online and sync in either order
expect: both accounts present on both devices; no conflict; identical merged snapshot bytes

name: competing_labels
operations: all three devices sync a baseline account with label 'GitHub'
phone edits label to 'GitHub (work)' while offline
laptop edits label to 'GitHub personal' while offline
all devices sync
expect: issuer label register holds two concurrent candidates on every device; conflict surfaced; no candidate silently dropped; resolved value identical everywhere after explicit resolution

name: identical_values_collapse
operations: both devices offline edit the same account's issuer to the identical string 'GitLab'
both devices sync
expect: identical concurrent values collapse to a single candidate; no conflict card shown

name: otp_config_atomic
operations: baseline account with secret S1, SHA1, 6 digits, 30s period
phone offline changes period to 60
laptop offline imports a new otpauth URI replacing the whole config with secret S2, SHA256, 8 digits, 30s
both devices sync
expect: otp_config register holds two concurrent complete configs; no merge may combine S1 with laptop parameters or S2 with phone parameters; user resolves to one complete config

name: delete_vs_edit
operations: baseline account on both devices
phone offline deletes the account (lifecycle -> deleted)
laptop offline edits the issuer label
both devices sync
expect: lifecycle and issuer are independent registers: edit survives and deletion is recorded; conflict surfaced for user decision rather than either change discarded

name: concurrent_resolutions
operations: create a two-candidate label conflict and sync it to both devices
phone resolves by keeping candidate A while offline
laptop resolves by keeping candidate B while offline
both devices sync
expect: both resolutions observed as concurrent writes; result is a new conflict state with the two resolution choices, not a crash and not a silent arbitrary pick; deterministic after final resolution

name: criss_cross_ancestry
operations: devices alternate syncs so each has revisions with parents the other has not seen (A1<-B1<-A2<-B2 ...)
both devices sync after several criss-cross rounds
expect: graph validation passes (no cycles, same-vault parents only); all revisions reachable; merged state converges identically on both devices regardless of sync order

name: missing_parent_incomplete
operations: phone creates revision R2 with parent R1 but R1 fails to upload
laptop lists the remote and sees R2 without R1
expect: laptop reports incomplete sync (exit code 4 via CLI); no merge performed; R2 is never treated as an arbitrary head

name: unrelated_roots_integrity
operations: tablet starts a fresh vault with a different vault_id and uploads to the same provider folder prefix
phone and laptop sync their own vault
expect: cross-vault parents rejected by graph validation; the two vaults never merge; each vault's state remains intact
